title: Constrain node telemetry to metadata fields
notes: Node reports currently accept any object and runner wall reports accept arbitrary names. Both are written to SQLite metadata, which is eligible for backups.
done_when: Define and enforce the supported host report fields and runner identifiers while preserving the metadata produced by the node and task loops.
result: Constrain node telemetry to metadata fields
evidence: API tests verify exact host fields, configured model and runner metadata, and accepted cooldowns. Node tests verify outbound reports and residency logs. codeality-go gate passed with 84.3% coverage.
